predictions.articleTitle: Omiya Ardija vs Montedio Yamagata Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Backup Keeper Kasahara Hold Firm?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Back Home Win / Draw paired with Under 2.5 Goals, as Omiya Ardija's 1.88 goals-per-match attack faces a depleted Yamagata defense while international goalkeeping and bench absences warrant covering the stalemate.
possibilityAssessment: Primary 1X2 Thesis: Home Win / Draw driven by Omiya's superior scoring output and 87.5% home unbeaten record balanced against Tom Glover's absence and zero wins from level half-times (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Secondary Totals Angle: Under 2.5 Goals anchored by a 2.44 combined lambda expectancy and Yamagata's 57.1% away fail-to-score rate (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)

Contingency Variance Angle: 2:1 narrow home victory (3 total goals) if Omiya hit their two-goal scoring rhythm while backup keeper Takashi Kasahara concedes once in transition (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Omiya's 1.88 goals/match attack tests Nishimura-less Yamagata without keeper Tom Glover.

spf.comment: Covers Omiya's primary 2:0 attacking win script and the 1:1 stalemate branch, because Glover's international absence and Omiya's 0-for-4 record from level half-times make a single home win too exposed.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.44 combined goal lambda (55.9% Poisson Under 2.5), Yamagata's 0.88 goals/match output, and their 1.00 goal-conceded defensive baseline.

score.comment: 2:0 reflects Omiya's 2.06 decayed scoring against a side that lost 0:2 in three of its last five games, while 1:1 captures Yamagata's 71.4% away half-time draw resilience.

goals.comment: 2 goals is the modal Poisson bucket (25.9%) covering both 2:0 and 1:1, with 3 goals covering the 2:1 branch if Omiya's backup keeper concedes.

bqc.comment: Omiya converted all eight half-time leads into wins (Win-Win), whereas level intervals saw Omiya go winless with 75% finishing Draw-Draw against Yamagata's 71.4% away half-time draw rate.
